description: Agent-ready DevOps, security, infrastructure, and compliance knowledge base with 80+ skills across Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS/Azure/GCP, AI platform operations, container hardening, SOC2/ISO27001, and incident response—plus ready-to-run scripts, templates, and playbooks for SRE, platform, and security teams.

summary.one_liner: A collection of 80+ (README headline says 160+) agent-readable DevOps, security, infrastructure, and compliance skill folders, each with a SKILL.md, scripts, references, and templates, for AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor.
keywords: install skills for my ai agent
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a catalog of Agent Skills, folders each containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter plus detailed guidance, configs, and CLI commands that AI agents load when a matching task comes up. The README lists skills grouped into DevOps (CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, observability, AI engineering, release management), Security (scanning, secrets, hardening, network security, AI security), Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, Cloudflare, databases, storage, networking, local AI serving, IT operations), and Compliance (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, governance, auditing, continuity). Each skill is described as including scripts, reference guides, and asset templates, though the README shows the layout rather than every file. Installation is via the skills.sh CLI (npx skills add) to install all or selected skills into a specific agent, or by cloning the repo. The README also says the material can be read by humans directly without an agent.
use_cases: Give an AI coding agent DevOps and Kubernetes operations knowledge
Prepare SOC2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA compliance documentation
Write Terraform or OpenTofu infrastructure code for AWS, Azure, or GCP
Set up security scanning and secrets management in CI/CD
Create incident response playbooks and on-call runbooks
Secure MCP servers and AI coding agent usage
Deploy and operate local or self-hosted LLM inference
how_to_run: npx skills add bagelhole/DevOps-Security-Agent-Skills --skill kubernetes-ops --skill hashicorp-vault -a cursor -y
notable: Skills are written as SKILL.md files that agents load on demand, with detailed guidance kept out of context until activated
Covers a broad span from DevOps and security to cloud, local AI inference, and compliance frameworks in one repo
Includes recent topics such as MCP server security, AI coding agent guardrails, eBPF observability, and OpenTofu migration
Installable selectively per skill and per agent (for example Cursor, Codex, Claude Code)
Usable without an agent as plain reference material with copy-paste configs
caveats: Skill count is inconsistent: the headline says 160+, while the section headers and catalog suggest roughly 80+ named skills
Many catalog entries are one-line descriptions; depth depends on each SKILL.md, which were not reviewed here
Configs and guidance are generic examples and must be adapted and verified before production use
Compliance skills are guidance, not certified audit or legal advice
